name: Lemonade / Kool-Aid (bulk mix)
notes: Pre-sweetened powdered mix: one ~82 oz canister makes ~34 qt. Mix in the coolers with camp water; keep one cooler of plain water too.

steps.text: Fill the 5-gal coolers with cold water and ice. Stir in the mix: one canister makes about 34 qt, so about half a canister per 5-gal cooler ({drink_mix} for this meal). Keep one cooler of plain water too.

serving: Serve from the spigot into mess-kit cups.
cleanup: Rinse the coolers; drain away from the campsite.
